purpose: Bounded build-aware package census and lexical predeclared min/max proof, not full Go type/import/runtime resolution
new_hypothesis: The earlier mixed-package refusal included an ignored time generator. Official go/build selection under an explicit profile can exclude it while preserving real shadowing refusals.

profiles.workspace: Explicit frozen standalone module; no ambient go.work, module downloads or vendor replacement
profiles.compiler: Existing preserved Go1.27.4 LinuxARM64 toolchain; exact identity checked before use
profiles.module_language: Read declared go version; builtin min/max requires at leastGo1.21; no newer-than-toolchain module accepted

proof_requirements: Complete frozen package Go-file census, exact source hashes and explicit build profile
Official go/build filtering, test exclusion and cgo-disabled selection
Selected function and source-file ownership unique
No package-level or conservative local declaration of the queried builtin name
Every unaliased import in the selected file has an exact registered source package-name census; never guess package name from path basename
Explicit alias shadows are refused; unresolved import sources remain inconclusive
Source/producer/profile/import-package identities participate in cache provenance
No type checking, service execution, numeric argument validity or whole-program success inferred
controls: Unshadowed predeclared call in owned package
Local variable, parameter, result and type-parameter shadowing
Package variable, constant, type and function shadowing in another active file
Same-named receiver method does not create a package binding
Explicit import alias shadows the builtin name
Unaliased import whose declared package name differs from its path basename
Missing registered import package remains inconclusive
Linux/Darwin filename and go:build selection differences
Ignored generator with package main does not contaminate a library census
Mixed active packages and duplicate selected functions refuse
Tests and cgo-only files excluded under the frozen profile
Invalid source, oversized input, duplicate JSON keys and unknown fields refuse
Dependency-only source changes alter the proof fingerprint
Qualified calls and absent requested bare calls do not become builtin facts
real_development_family: Temporal SDK7e0d845 internal/createDynamicServiceRetryPolicy plus exact backoff and preserved standard-library context/time packages
family_status: Development-exposed previous failure, not independent holdout
